## Storage Location

Claude Code stores complete conversation history locally in JSONL files at `~/.claude/projects/`.

## Directory Structure

The directory structure is organized as:
- `~/.claude/projects/` - Project conversations
  - `[project-name]/` - Individual project directories
    - `*.jsonl` - Conversation files

More specifically, conversations are stored as: `~/.claude/projects/[project-hash]/[session-id].jsonl`

## File Format

The conversation history files are stored in `.jsonl` format (JSON Lines), which are hard to read and search through in their raw form.

## Current Limitations

Currently, Claude Code stores conversation history exclusively in the centralized `~/.claude/` directory, and directory names are encoded (e.g., `/mypath/my_project/` becomes `-mypath-my-project`), which means when renaming/moving projects, the `~/.claude/projects/` subdirectory must be manually renamed to maintain /resume functionality.

Several third-party tools have been developed to help users view, search, and export these conversation files, as there's no built-in export feature in Claude Code itself.

else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Backup failed!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi
